onset.Description: Start of the trial, relative to the start of the recording

duration.Description: True length of the recorded signal

question_id.Description: Question number (1-32); equal to the run label

block.Description: Session block (1 = personal information, 2 = general knowledge, 3 = control, 4 = situation-based; asked in this order)

label_source.Description: How the truth/lie label was obtained

Levels.assigned: Assigned by the protocol before the session
Levels.self_report: Marked by the participant after the session
